title: Yeoman
description: Yeoman — Tool That Builds Tools (public edition). Real documented tool; god-mode caveat applies.
body: Yeoman is a real, publicly documented software tool relevant to Tool That Builds Tools. Scaffolding system whose generators are themselves tools built from generator specifications. In the context of the god-mode vision, it represents the current real-world state of the art for part of what "Tool That Builds Tools" aspires to do: Generates a new tool from a specification, including implementation, interface, documentation, and tests.. Its documented capabilities include component assembly and pipeline orchestration, and it is used in production or research settings today. Like every tool in this database, it is presented strictly as what it is: a real tool with real, verifiable behavior — not as the aspirational god-mode system itself. Per the source paste's own caveat, "god mode" here means the highest level of ambition in software capability, not unlimited computation, infallible AI, or technology that has already been demonstrated.
